Name: sleeveColor
Author: someoneElsHere
Description:
This is a stardew Valley mod that allows you to change sleeve color, suggested idea by Orphea. Open your inventory and at your inventory page there will be a box with 3 sliders. Top slider is red, next is green, and next blue. Each sleeve color is unique to that shirt.
This mod saves data in a text file! If you want to remove data.. (not reccomended)
Open the file (create a dupe incase you mess up)
The data is stored the following way
[code]SHIRT_ID : R : G : B[/code]
Remove the shirt ID line that you want.
Adding more characters will mess up the file
Have fun!
